slide2.subtitle: DoD-only ladder, no NASA share required. Refueling/logistics leads; storable RDRE is the FTV propulsion enabler.
left: USSF Objective Force plan (Apr 2026): demonstrate refueling + augmented-maneuver tugs 2025–30; make refueling operational + high-thrust reusable OTVs 2030–35; on-orbit logistics architecture 2035–40.
USSPACECOM Dynamic Space Operations / maneuver without regret needs on-orbit resupply. RG-XX is the first NSS program with a refueling requirement ($355M FY27; >$2.7B over the FYDP).
Commercial stations as refueling depots: a second revenue line that helps make LEO stations sustainable. SSC's 'orbital warehousing' topic is the closest DoD demand signal today.
NOAA WB-57 sampling found spacecraft-reentry metals (Al, Cu, Li, niobium, hafnium) in ~10% of stratospheric aerosol particles (Murphy et al., PNAS 2023).
Models project mega-constellation reentries could exceed 360 t/yr of alumina, with open questions on ozone and upper-atmosphere effects (GRL 2024; JGR 2025).
Refuel, service and reuse on orbit lower the number of vehicles disposed of by reentry, which fits debris rules and the atmospheric concern alike.
Reusable VTVL flight testbed to 100 km+ (in-space firing + µg transfer, recovered and reflown), integration, and Type V tank / zero-loss transfer systems.
Engine: storable RDRE, government-furnished or candidate GTL build, selected by trade study. Interfaces designed to mate with SERB-approved refueling ports (RAFTI / PRM).

SpaceWERX + SSC Servicing, Mobility & Logistics. Topics: propellant management, tank refuelability, transfer metering, FTV/OTV. Also: SSC Front Door intake + SpEC (NSTXL) membership.
On hold pending AFWERX/SpaceWERX guidance. Submit within the next window. Sponsor: AFRL/RQ Rocket Propulsion (GS-15 branch/division lead). Match: TX Space Commission SEARF $2M (board 11 Dec 2026).

15 USC 638(r) off the Phase II; no competition required. Non-SBIR funds from AFRL/RQ (PE 0602203F / USSF PE 1206601SF, Rocket Propulsion Technology) and AFRL/RV for the in-space mission. SPRINT BAA white paper as the S&T bridge.

Government-Only Matching Option: $1 SBIR : $2 non-SBIR federal (e.g., $3M + $6M), no private or NASA share. Alternative: Strategic Breakthrough (up to $30M, ≥20% DoW program funds). Match signatory: SSC SML.
SpEC OTA prototype ($10–60M), then SAML PE 1203955SF, supplier to RG-XX refueling vendors, and the Objective Force high-thrust reusable OTV line (2030–35).
(1) Sponsor TACFI when guidance posts. (2) Name the Phase III funding office. (3) Introduce us to SSC SML for the Orbital Logistics Challenge and the STRATFI match.
